reasoning: Denis Sassou Nguesso has dominated Congolese politics for decades, winning every election since 2002 despite fraud allegations. He controls state apparatus, media, and security forces. The opposition is fragmented, under-resourced, and key figures are imprisoned. The 2015 constitutional changes were specifically designed to enable his continued rule. At 82, health could be a factor, but he was just nominated by his party in December 2025. Given the authoritarian nature of the regime and historical patterns, his victory is highly likely.
